AgentInvocationPayload.description: A model call finished (successfully or not).
AgentInvocationPayload.title: AgentInvocationPayload

AgentStartedPayload.description: A model call is about to be sent. Pairs with ``agent_invocation``.
AgentStartedPayload.title: AgentStartedPayload

BenchmarkAggregate.description:
An arm's results, over all tasks (task_id null) or one task.
Rates and means are over counted trials only, except the cancellation
and interrupted rates (over non_warmup_trials).
BenchmarkAggregate.title: BenchmarkAggregate

BenchmarkCreateRequest.description: A new experiment: a fixed suite and fixed arms, by id. Nothing else.

repetitions.description: Measured repetitions per arm and task. One warm-up repetition per arm and task is added, run first and excluded from every result.
repetitions.title: Repetitions

BenchmarkCreateRequest.title: BenchmarkCreateRequest

BenchmarkTimingAggregate.description:
Run timings over counted trials whose measurements were recorded;
other counted trials are counted in unavailable, by status.
BenchmarkTimingAggregate.title: BenchmarkTimingAggregate

BenchmarkTimingSummary.description:
One timing metric over the measured trials: n established it,
missing did not (by reason); median is interpolated for even n, P95 is
nearest-rank (an observed value).
BenchmarkTimingSummary.title: BenchmarkTimingSummary

BenchmarkTrialMetrics.description: What a trial's run established; null means not established (see null_reasons).
BenchmarkTrialMetrics.title: BenchmarkTrialMetrics

BenchmarkTrialTimings.description:
A counted trial's run timings from its persisted span measurements.

``*_busy_ms`` and ``*_total_ms`` are sums over possibly overlapping
intervals (time spent, not elapsed); ``*_wall_ms`` and the phases are
elapsed time. Null means not established (see null_reasons; ``*``
covers every field when the run has no usable measurements).
BenchmarkTrialTimings.title: BenchmarkTrialTimings

BudgetPayload.description: A call was refused or abandoned by the ledger.
BudgetPayload.title: BudgetPayload

FailurePayload.description:
Every failure: ``error`` always; agent context only where it applies.

Orchestration-level failures (graph errors, crashes) carry no role, step,
or attempt. The remaining fields are diagnostics specific to one cause.
FailurePayload.title: FailurePayload

Limits.description:
Autonomy envelope for a single run.

Values are validated against the process ceiling by ``clamp_limits`` before
a run starts; a caller can tighten a limit but not widen it.
Limits.title: Limits

Limits-Input.description:
Autonomy envelope for a single run.

Values are validated against the process ceiling by ``clamp_limits`` before
a run starts; a caller can tighten a limit but not widen it.
Limits-Input.title: Limits

Limits-Output.description:
Autonomy envelope for a single run.

Values are validated against the process ceiling by ``clamp_limits`` before
a run starts; a caller can tighten a limit but not widen it.
Limits-Output.title: Limits

identifier.description: The account's email or phone number
identifier.title: Identifier

MeasurementPersistence.description:
Trace and run-row writes during the run (the terminal write is not in
the row: it happens after the measurements are serialized).
MeasurementPersistence.title: MeasurementPersistence

MeasurementSpan.description:
One span on the run's monotonic clock: ms offsets from the lifecycle
start; ``end_ms`` null when the span never closed.
MeasurementSpan.title: MeasurementSpan

RepairPayload.description: Unparseable structured output; the call is retried with a repair note.
RepairPayload.title: RepairPayload

RetryPayload.description:
``scope="call"``: one agent call is retried after a transient error.
``scope="steps"``: failed plan steps are re-dispatched.
RetryPayload.title: RetryPayload

RunMeasurements.description:
A run's stored timing measurements, or why there are none.

Only numbers, enums and validated ids: no free text. ``unknown`` names
each metric that is null and why (incomplete, never started, spans
dropped, not applicable, ...). Nothing is ever derived from wall-clock
event timestamps.
RunMeasurements.title: RunMeasurements

RunStreamEnd.description:
The data of the ``end`` message that closes a run's event stream.

The stream (``GET /api/runs/{run_id}/stream``) is Server-Sent Events:
``trace`` messages carry one ``TraceEvent`` each with ``id`` set to its
``seq``; ``end`` is sent once the run is terminal and every event has
been delivered. Comment lines are keepalives, not events.
RunStreamEnd.title: RunStreamEnd

RunSummary.description:
A run as listed in history: everything except plan details, review
text, verification output, the summary, and generated file contents.
RunSummary.title: RunSummary

payload.description: Kind-specific data; see the TraceEventPayloads schema for the payload model of each kind.
payload.title: Payload

TraceEventPayloads.description: The payload schema for each TraceEvent.kind. TraceEvent.payload conforms to the entry for its kind for events recorded by this version; older stored traces are returned as recorded.
TraceEventPayloads.title: TraceEventPayloads

VerificationStartedPayload.description: The deterministic test runner is about to start. Not a model call.
VerificationStartedPayload.title: VerificationStartedPayload

Create an experiment and start running it in the background.

Fixed suites and arms only, by id: no goals, files, models or limits.
In the public demo: operators only, public suites and the server's

An experiment with its provenance, per-arm aggregates and every trial
(linked to its run). Unknown metric values are null, with reasons.

Cancel an experiment running in this server process: its current run
is cancelled and its remaining trials never start. In the public demo,
operators only.

The benchmark suites and arms this server offers (the public demo
shows only public suites, and lets only operators create).

List models from the configured endpoint. No inference, no cost.

Numbers, enums and validated ids only; the stored row is revalidated on

Read-only: it streams runs that exist, exactly the events
